provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Lower Makefield, Chapter 200 Zoning, as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code LO1561): includes legislation through 12-17-2025. New Laws (21). Two amend Chapter 200: Ord. No. 474 (2026-08-19, conditional uses in C-2) and Ord. No. 476 (2026-09-16, definition of 'structure'). Neither adds ADUs. Read in the eCode360 print view in a browser.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: Includes legislation through 12-17-2025. New Laws (21), two for Chapter 200 (Ord. 474 and 476), neither about dwellings.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, accessory apartment or in-law rule. Each residential district lists its uses 'and no other' (200-15, 200-20, 200-24, 200-28, 200-32)
R-1 and R-2 allow only single-family detached dwellings. A second unit on such a lot needs a use variance
A dwelling unit is a unit with living, sleeping, cooking, bathing and eating facilities for one family (200-7)

Two-family dwellings are a use by right in R-3 and R-4 (200-24A(4), 200-32A(5)). In R-3 they are a development type: 10-acre tract, 6,000 sq ft of net lot area per dwelling unit, 40% of the site in resource protection and open space (200-26A)
Boarding: up to two boarders in a single-family detached house by special exception in R-1, on 16,000 sq ft, with no added rooms (200-15B(10), 200-69A(3)). Boarders do not get a separate unit
Residential accessory buildings: behind the middle of the house depth, 15 ft high. 5 ft from side and rear lines under 200 sq ft, 10 ft from any line above 200 sq ft (200-69A(14)(a))
Parking: two spaces per dwelling unit for a single-family detached dwelling, 2.5 per unit for other residential uses (200-79A)
Short-term lodging is barred except owner-occupied rental of up to two bedrooms, or rental of a whole unit for 7 to 30 days, with a township license (130-3, 130-4)

term.note: No ADU term. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, elder cottage, ECHO, carriage, guest house, servant, caretaker, second dwelling, conversion.

status.note: The code has no ADU text.

path.note: R-1 lists uses 'and no other'. A second unit is not listed, so a use variance is the path. The code has no unlisted-use special exception.

value.name: Two-family dwelling (development)
value.conditions: Two-family dwellings as a development: minimum tract 10 acres, 6,000 sq ft of net lot area per dwelling unit, 4.5 units per acre, 40% of the site in resource protection and open space. Not a lot-by-lot option for an existing house.

value.name: Two-family dwelling
value.conditions: Use by right. Lot and tract standards of 200-34 not recorded here.

alternatives.note: No conversion of an existing house is listed.

historic_bypass.note: No ADU text, so no historic path.

value.condition: Short-term lodging is barred except owner-occupied rental of up to two bedrooms, or a whole unit for 7 to 30 days, with a township license.
Residential accessory buildings stand only in side or rear yards 'behind the median line of the residential dwelling'.

gates.note: Rules that reach any second unit.

max_height_ft.note: Accessory rule, not an ADU rule: 'No accessory building or structure shall exceed 15 feet in height.'

setback_front_ft.note: No number. Not in front yards, and behind the median line of the house.

setback_side_ft.note: Buildings over 200 sq ft 'not less than 10 feet from any property line'. 5 ft under 200 sq ft.

setback_rear_ft.note: Same as side. 5 ft under 200 sq ft.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: Detached accessory buildings use the 5 and 10 ft rules. A garage joined by a breezeway is part of the principal building and meets district yards.

internal_uses_district_height.note: A unit inside or attached to the house takes the 35 ft district height.

family_only.note: No ADU rule. A family is related persons or up to five unrelated persons, excluding servants, with single cooking facilities.

short_term_rental_banned.note: No ADU rule. Short-term lodging is limited town-wide: two bedrooms in an owner-occupied house, or a whole unit for 7 to 30 days, with a license.

max_adus.note: Reading: 0 means the code allows no ADU.

reading.value: No ADU row. Single-family detached: two spaces per dwelling unit. If the second unit counts as a dwelling unit, four. Other residential uses need 2.5 per unit.

min_lot_sqft.note: Lot size depends on resource protection land: 34,000 sq ft (0% to 24%), 22,000 (25% to 67%), 15,000 (68% and up). 34,000 with on-lot water or sewer. Yards here are for the 15,000 sq ft tier.

setback_front_ft.note: 15,000 sq ft lot: front 35. 34,000 sq ft lot: front 50.

setback_side_ft.note: 15,000 sq ft lot: 15 ft each. 34,000 sq ft lot: 25 ft.

setback_rear_ft.note: 15,000 sq ft lot: 45 ft. 34,000 sq ft lot: 70 ft.

min_lot_sqft.note: Smallest lot tier in the R-2 table, 85 ft wide. Larger tiers to 34,000 sq ft. Yards here are for the 12,500 sq ft tier.
